details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 5, Spare

A blue-scaled dragonborn with a long staff, a red sash and a crackle of lightning behind his teeth. Calm and dry-humoured, he speaks softly, laughs at thunder and follows his own conscience over any law. Kiyo's students walk with the Keepers, and Sarrix has walked with them longer than most.

In a fight

Close fast at 50ft, strike with the staff and a second unarmed blow, and try a Stun Attack on the most dangerous foe. Breathe lightning down a line of enemies, and turn aside arrows and blades with Deflect Missiles and Deflect Blow.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Fast Movement and AC. Speed 50ft and AC 16 from the Monk table (Dexterity does not add), plus 1 for your ring. Armour or a shield replaces the table AC; over your carrying limit you lose Fast Movement and move at 30ft.

Hand-to-Hand Combat. Unarmed strikes deal 1d10 using Strength or Dexterity, lethal or subdual as you choose. When you use your action to attack, you also make a second unarmed strike (1d6), rolled normally. Advantage on all grappling and overbearing attacks. A Monk never gains Extra Attack.

Weapon Mastery (staff). +1 to attack and damage with your staff (included); once a round, reroll one missed attack with it. Stun Attack and Deflect Missiles work through it.

Stun Attack. Declare before the attack roll, once a round, 9 times a day; a miss still counts. On a hit the target makes a Fortitude save (DC 16) or is Stunned for 1 round. Your first stun attempt must be a primary attack.

Parrying Stance. While unarmed and unarmoured, once a round when struck in melee, add +2 (Wisdom) to your AC against that attack, after the attacker rolls.

Deflect Missiles and Deflect Blow (Dexterity). 2 attempts a round, out of turn. When hit by a nonmagical ranged weapon (with a hand free), or struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20+0) against the attack roll; succeed and it is negated entirely.

Catch Weapon (Dexterity). Once a round, out of turn, when struck in melee, a Dexterity check against the attack roll catches the weapon.

Iron Discipline. +3 to saves against disease, poison, paralysis, polymorph, petrification and death attacks (Iron Body), and against confusion, charm, fear and mind-affecting spells (Iron Mind).

Iron Fists. Your unarmed strikes count as magic weapons.

Slow Fall. Within 10ft of a wall as you fall, treat the fall as 30ft shorter.

Ascetic Recovery. Feign Death for up to 9 minutes. Fast Healing: once a day, after a long rest, regain 9 HP.

Body of Iron. Once a day, at the start of your turn, end one condition on yourself (Stunned, Paralysed, Poisoned, Frightened, Charmed and the like). No action, and it works while Incapacitated.

Kit: Dragon's Reflex. A natural 15 or higher on your Deflect Blow check succeeds, whatever the attack roll.

Kit: Kiyo's Legacy. Advantage on checks to identify or learn about The Omniscience and its agents; the Keepers of Tariel know you as an ally on sight.

Dragonborn (Lightning). Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to lightning. Once a day, breathe lightning in a line or cone: 9 damage, Reflex save (DC 15) for half (1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Charisma checks towards dragon-kin and true dragons.

Toughness (1st, General). +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

Flowing Strikes (2nd, Martial). Once a round, when you hit with a melee attack, make one more melee attack: with Disadvantage against the creature you hit, a normal roll against a different one in reach.

Alertness (6th, Specialist). You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 to initiative.

HP. 1st level: d10 max 10 + Con 1 = 11. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (6 + 1) = 56. Toughness: 9. Total 76.

Armour Class on the sheet: 16 (Monk table at 9th; Dexterity does not add) + 1 (Ring of Protection) = 17

Class Abilities

1st Level

Fast Movement

  • Effect: Monk moves at the rate shown in the table above. Being over the carrying limit removes Fast Movement and reduces this to 30ft.

Iron Discipline

  • Effect: Bonus to saving throws, shown in the Monk Progression Table.
  • Iron Body applies from 1st level against disease, poison, paralysis, polymorph, petrification, and death attacks.
  • Iron Mind applies from 8th level against confusion, charm, fear, and mind-affecting spells.

Stun Attack

  • Effect: Declare before making the attack roll. On a hit, the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is Stunned for 1 round (1d4 rounds from 10th level). Deals normal unarmed damage.
  • Usable once per round, limited to once per level per day — a missed attack counts against the daily limit
  • First stun attempt must be a primary attack

Parrying Stance

  • Effect: While unarmed and unarmoured, once per round when struck in melee, add your Wisdom modifier to your AC against that single attack, applied after the attacker rolls.

Hand-to-Hand Combat

  • Effect: See the table above for unarmed damage by level.
  • Your unarmed attacks use Strength or Dexterity (your choice).
  • At 6th level you gain a second unarmed attack, and at 16th a third, whenever you use your action to attack (the Secondary and Tertiary columns).
  • They are rolled normally, are not off-hand attacks, and stack with Flowing Strikes and Haste.
  • A Monk never gains Extra Attack.
  • The monk has Advantage on all overbearing and grappling attacks
  • The monk may choose whether a successful strike deals normal damage or subdual damage

2nd Level

Deflect Missiles (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Up to the attempts per round shown in the Monk Progression Table (these happen out of turn; you cannot deflect while surprised or Incapacitated), when hit by a nonmagical ranged weapon (arrows, axes, bolas, bolts, clubs, daggers, darts, hammers, javelins, nets, rocks, spears), make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attack roll to deflect it entirely (no damage). Must have at least one free hand.
  • Scales: once per round at 2nd level, up to five times per round at 20th — see the Monk Progression Table
  • Cannot use against siege weapons

3rd Level

Iron Fists

  • Effect: Your unarmed attacks count as magic weapons, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt. They gain no bonus to hit or damage.

4th Level

Slow Fall

  • Effect: If within 10ft of a vertical surface while falling, use it to slow descent — treat the fall as if it were 20ft shorter.
  • Reduction improves with level — see the Monk Progression Table (20ft at 4th, up to 40ft at 18th)

Weapon Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one weapon to master — gain +1 damage and +1 to attack rolls while wielding it, and once per round you may reroll one missed attack roll with it. The weapon becomes an extension of the body: Stun Attack, Deflect Missiles and Death Strike can all be performed with the mastered weapon, extending those abilities' reach and style.

5th Level

Deflect Blow (Dexterity)

  • Effect: When struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attacker's attack roll.
  • On success, deflect the blow entirely.
  • You have the same number of attempts per round as Deflect Missiles (see the Monk Progression Table); each use spends one of those attempts.
  • Does not work against ranged attacks, spells, or breath weapons

6th Level

Ascetic Recovery

  • Effect: Feign Death: slow vital functions until appearing dead. Maintain the state for minutes equal to character level.
  • Fast Healing: Once per day, after a long rest, regain 1 HP per Monk level.

7th Level

Catch Weapon (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Once per round, when struck in melee, attempt to catch the weapon (out of turn; unusable while surprised or Incapacitated).
  • Make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attacker's attack roll.
  • On success, the monk holds whatever the opponent is wielding (or catches it mid-air).
  • The opponent may attempt to wrest it back with a Strength check; the monk uses Dexterity
  • The wielder may release the weapon at any time

8th Level

Iron Mind

  • Effect: Your Iron Discipline save bonus now also applies against confusion, charm, fear and mind-affecting spells, at the Iron Mind value in the Monk Progression Table.

9th Level

  • Body of Iron: Once per day, at the start of your turn, end one condition affecting the Monk (stunned, paralysed, poisoned, frightened, charmed, etc.). It costs no action and works even while incapacitated.

10th Level

Death Strike

  • Effect: Once per day, declare before the attack roll. The target's Level must be no more than half your Monk level. On a hit that deals damage, the target must make a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or die instantly.
  • A 12th level monk may delay the death — the target dies at any point the monk chooses within rounds equal to monk's level, or the monk can release the sentence with a successful touch attack instead
  • The death strike has no effect on undead, oozes, elementals, or creatures that magic weapons cannot harm

13th Level

  • Untouchable: Once per day, when an attack would hit the Monk, negate it entirely as if the attack had missed, with no roll required. Does not work against attacks the Monk cannot perceive (invisible, surprise, etc.).

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

  • Quick Reflexes: +1 to initiative rolls

20th Level

  • Body of Iron Made Whole: Body of Iron now removes all conditions currently affecting the Monk and heals 4d8 HP.

24th Level

Quick Reflexes (Improved)

  • Effect: +2 to initiative. Once per encounter, take one extra action in the first round — one additional attack or half movement.
  • Untouchable improves: usable a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), once per round.

Feats of Arneyan

The Monk may choose from the Martial Path at any Feat level without needing to multiclass.

Kits: Monastic Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Monk folder. Drag one onto your character.

Monk Kits represent the tradition, school, or circumstance that shaped the character's training.

• Founded by Kiyo, whose hidden monastery in Tenor trains those seeking to avenge their master's death at the hands of The Omniscience.
  • The order has strong ties to the Keepers of Tariel.
  • Kiyo's teachings centre on freedom and the absence of the ego — students are encouraged to become adventurers, to protect the weak, and to follow their own moral compass above any law.
  • Many Disciples travel alongside the Keepers while striving to embody Kiyo's example.

  • Kiyo's Legacy: Advantage on checks to identify or gather information about The Omniscience or their agents, and recognised as an ally on sight by the Keepers of Tariel.

(Constitution) Gain +1 Max HP per level (retroactive). Gain +1 to Constitution (once, on taking this feat). Advantage on Constitution-based checks.

Open to all classes by default.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, let the momentum carry through — make one extra melee attack.

  • Against the creature you just hit it is rolled with Disadvantage; against a different creature within your reach it is a normal roll.
  • The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.text: Once per round, after hitting a creature with a melee attack. The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again. A different creature within your reach.

Nothing gets past you unnoticed — not the shift in a shadow, not the change in someone's breathing before they act.
